{{Short description|Italian mathematician and priest}}
[[File:Griminelli_-_Novissima_prattica_d'aritmetica_mercantile,_1670_-_872726.jpg|thumb|''Novissima prattica d'aritmetica mercantile'', title page (1670)]]

'''Domenico Griminelli''' was a [[17th-century]] [[Italians|Italian]] [[mathematician]] and [[Catholic Church|Catholic]] [[priest]] from [[Correggio, Emilia-Romagna]].<ref name="Maifreda2010">{{cite book|first=Germano|last=Maifreda|title=L'economia e la scienza: il rinnovamento della cultura economica fra Cinque e Seicento|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=8VtQAQAAIAAJ|year=2010|publisher=Edizioni di storia e letteratura|language=it|pages=54, 99|isbn=9788863721379}}</ref>

He published in 1656<ref name="Editions" /> a tutorial book on [[arithmetic]] for [[shopkeeper]]s and [[merchant]]s,<ref name="Maifreda2010" /><ref name="Purificazione1749">{{cite book|author=Alessandro della Purificazione|title=Arimmetica pratica divisa in quindici trattati|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=H8tJAAAAMAAJ&pg=PA452|year=1749|publisher=Nella stamperia di S. Michele a Ripa, per O. Puccinelli |language=it |pages=452–}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|journal=Matematicamente.it|number=12|date= May 2011 |title=154. Moltiplicazione| first =Michele T.|last=Mazzucato|language=it}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=Scuola e insegnamento: atti del XXXV convegno di Studi maceratesi. Abbadia di Fiastra (Tolentino), 13-14 novembre 1999|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=pY5oAAAAMAAJ|year=2001|publisher=Centro di studi storici maceratesi|language=it|page=566}}</ref> ''Novissima prattica d'aritmetica mercantile'' ("Brand-new practice of mercantile arithmetic"), also known outside Italy<ref name="HoockJeannin1993">{{cite book|author1=Jochen Hoock|author2=Pierre Jeannin|title=Ars Mercatoria: Handbücher und Traktate für den Gebrauch des Kaufmanns, 1470-1820|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Ux66AAAAIAAJ|year=1993|publisher=Schöningh|language=de|isbn=978-3-506-74402-9|page=196}}</ref><ref name="Peláez1984">{{cite book|author=Manuel J. Peláez|title=Cambios y Seguros Marítimos en Derecho Catalán y Balear|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BkQSAAAAYAAJ|year=1984|publisher=Publicaciones del Real Colegio de España|language=es|isbn=978-84-499-6903-4|page=xxxi}}</ref><ref name="Peláez1994">{{cite book|author=Manuel J. Peláez|title=Historia del derecho de la navegación I: trabajos de teoría e historia de derecho marítimo y de derecho aeronáutico|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3VcSAAAAYAAJ|year=1994|publisher=Cátedra de Historia del Derecho y de las Instituciones, Universidad de Málaga|language=es|page=42|isbn=9788460491002}}</ref> and reprinted for two centuries.<ref name="LucchettiCiliberto2011">{{cite book|author1=Roberto Lucchetti|author2=Ciro Ciliberto|title=Un mondo di idee: La matematica ovunque|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=j6dEsq1-rlcC|year=2011|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|language=it|isbn=978-88-470-1744-3|page=110}}</ref> The book's introduction echoed [[Plato]] in declaring numbers to be a divine gift, without which civilization would vanish, and dedicated the work to cardinal [[Girolamo Gastaldi]], the General Treasurer of the [[Apostolic Camera]].<ref>{{cite book|title=From Oikonomia to Political Economy: Constructing Economic Knowledge from the Renaissance to the Scientific Revolution|first=Germano|last=Maifreda|publisher=Routledge|year=2016|isbn=9781317131984|pages=66–67|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=kvIGDAAAQBAJ&pg=PA66}}</ref>
